provenance_statement: This fixture is an internally generated MentorAmp development reference. It is NOT an independent LifeLib oracle run. It provides verified mathematical expectations for account-value rollforward, free withdrawal thresholding, surrender charges, and contractual MGSV accumulation.

anchor_case.description: Anchor benchmark: $100k single premium, 5-yr guarantee at 4.50%, $4,000 partial withdrawal at month 12.

excess_withdrawal_case.description: Excess partial withdrawal benchmark: $100k premium, 5-yr guarantee at 4.50%, $20,000 gross withdrawal at month 24 exceeding 10% free limit ($10,050 free, $9,950 chargeable at 6% SC).
